landing.metaDescription: Guests, RSVPs, seating chart, budget, venues, travel, inspiration and your wedding website – all in one calm place, in your language.
landing.title: Everything for your wedding, in one calm place.
landing.intro: Plan your guests, RSVPs, seating, budget, venues and travel with your partner and family, from your phone or laptop.
landing.featuresTitle: One app instead of twelve spreadsheets
landing.featuresText: Every part of your plan talks to the others. RSVPs flow into the seating chart, booked venues flow into your website.

guests.title: Guest list
guests.text: Households, sides, dietary needs and CSV import in minutes.

rsvp.title: RSVPs
rsvp.text: One private link per household. Answers arrive live.

seating.title: Seating chart
seating.text: Drag guests onto seats. Keep families together, exes apart.

budget.title: Budget
budget.text: Categories, deposits and due dates, with no surprises.

venues.title: Venues & vendors
venues.text: Compare side by side, then book with confidence.

travel.title: Hotels & travel
travel.text: Room blocks, flights and an arrivals board for pickups.

inspiration.title: Inspiration
inspiration.text: Pin ideas, pull colour palettes and decide together.

website.title: Wedding website
website.text: Five beautiful templates with RSVP built in.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.text: A to-do plan from twelve months out to the big day.

languages.title: 25 languages
languages.text: You plan in your language; every guest gets the website, RSVP and emails in theirs.

landing.closingText: Invite your partner, parents or planner, and plan it all together in real time.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in or create your account. No password needed.
login.errorLink: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Please request a new one.
login.errorGoogle: Google sign-in isn’t available right now. Please use your email instead.
login.sentTo: We sent an email to {email}. Click the link in it (in this browser), or type the code from the email below.
login.resent: A new code has been sent to your email.
login.setupTitle: Almost there: Supabase isn’t connected yet.
login.setupText: Create a .env.local file with your Supabase URL and publishable key (see .env.example and the README), then restart npm run dev.

welcome.title: Choose your language
welcome.intro: Vow will speak this language everywhere. You can change it any time in the account menu.
welcome.guestsNote: Your guests will see the website, RSVP page and emails in their own language — you set that for each household.

names.title: Who’s getting married?
